question: A dispute petition in the election of the President of the India can be filed in:

options.text: Both, the Supreme Court of India and the High Court of any state
Only the Supreme Court of India
Any court within the territory of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Only the Supreme Court of India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A dispute related to the election of the President of India can only be filed in the **Supreme Court of India**.
 
• **Article 71 of the Indian Constitution specifie**s that the Supreme Court has the exclusive jurisdiction to resolve any disputes or doubts regarding the election of the President or Vice-President of India.
 
• The Supreme Court has the sole authority to decide on any disputes regarding the election of the President or the Vice-President of India.
 
• Other courts,** including High Courts or any other lower courts, do not have the jurisdiction to hear disputes related to presidential elections.**
